subject: Information Theory
title: Signal Processing in AI
description: Learn Signal Processing in AI in one minute.

hook.text: Siri hears your voice through noise, traffic, and wind. Signal processing cleans the audio before AI interprets it.

buildup.text: Speech recognition starts with filtering, spectral analysis, and feature extraction—all signal processing.

discovery.text: Convolutional neural networks are essentially learned filters. They extract features the same way classical filters do.

twist.text: AI didn't replace signal processing. It learned to do it automatically from data instead of hand-tuned equations.

climax.text: Self-driving cars, medical AI, and language models all begin with signal processing as their sensory front end.

punchline.text: AI listens, sees, and senses. Signal processing is how.

quiz.question: How does signal processing relate to AI?
options: Signal processing prepares raw data for AI to interpret
AI has replaced all signal processing
